title: Lesson 48 · Did you want to tell me something?
titleZh: 第48课 你想对我说什么吗？

examples.en: My dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth.
examples.zh: 我的牙医刚给我拔掉一颗牙。

examples.en: I go to the dentist twice a year.
Dentists ask questions when it is impossible for you to answer.
examples.zh: 牙医在你无法回答时提问。

examples.en: It is impossible to finish the work in one day.
examples.zh: 一天内完成这项工作是不可能的。

examples.en: The dentist pulled out one of my teeth.
examples.zh: 牙医拔掉了我的一颗牙。

examples.en: Pull the door open, please.
He had pulled out the wrong tooth.
Brush your teeth every morning.
My mouth was full of cotton wool.
The dentist put cotton wool in my mouth.
examples.zh: 牙医把药棉放进我嘴里。

examples.en: I collected match boxes.
He collects stamps.
He asked me whether my collection was growing.
examples.zh: 他问我收藏是否在增加。

examples.en: She has a large collection of stamps.
I collected match boxes.
There are some matches in the match box.
My collection was growing.
The trees grow fast in summer.
Meanwhile, my tongue was busy searching out the hole.
examples.zh: 与此同时，我的舌头忙着寻找牙洞。

examples.en: Mother went shopping. Meanwhile, I cleaned the house.
examples.zh: 妈妈去买东西。与此同时，我打扫了房子。

examples.en: My tongue was busy searching out the hole.
examples.zh: 我的舌头忙着寻找牙洞。

examples.en: The doctor looked at his tongue.
My tongue was searching out the hole.
The police searched the house.
My tongue searched out the hole where the tooth had been.
examples.zh: 我的舌头找到了那颗牙留下的洞。

examples.en: There is a hole in the wall.
The dentist removed the cotton wool from my mouth.
examples.zh: 牙医从我嘴里取出了药棉。

examples.en: Please remove your books from the table.
examples.zh: 请把你的书从桌上拿走。

examples.en: In answer to his questions I nodded.
She nodded to me in the street.
He had pulled out the wrong tooth.
You are wrong about him.

sentences.en: My dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth and had told me to rest for a while.
sentences.zh: 我的牙科医生刚刚给我拔掉了一颗牙，并嘱咐我休息一会儿。

sentences.en: I tried to say something, but my mouth was full of cotton wool.
sentences.zh: 我想说点什么，但我的嘴里塞满了药棉。

sentences.en: He knew I collected match boxes and asked me whether my collection was growing.
sentences.zh: 他知道我收集火柴盒，于是问我收藏的火柴盒是否在增加。

sentences.en: In answer to these questions I either nodded or made strange noises.
sentences.zh: 对这些问题，我不是点头，就是发出奇怪的声音。

sentences.en: I suddenly felt very worried, but I could not say anything.
sentences.zh: 我突然非常着急，但却什么也说不出来。

article.en: Dentists always ask questions when it is impossible for you to answer.
article.zh: 牙科医生总是在你无法作答的时候向你提问。

article.en: My dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth and had told me to rest for a while.
article.zh: 我的牙科医生刚刚给我拔掉了一颗牙，并嘱咐我休息一会儿。

article.en: I tried to say something, but my mouth was full of cotton wool.
article.zh: 我想说点什么，但我的嘴里塞满了药棉。

article.en: He knew I collected match boxes and asked me whether my collection was growing.
article.zh: 他知道我收集火柴盒，于是问我收藏的火柴盒是否在增加。

article.en: He then asked me how my brother was and whether I liked my new job in London.
article.zh: 接着他又问我兄弟近来如何，是否喜欢伦敦的新工作。

article.en: In answer to these questions I either nodded or made strange noises.
article.zh: 对这些问题，我不是点头，就是发出奇怪的声音。

article.en: Meanwhile, my tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been.
article.zh: 与此同时，我的舌头正在忙着寻找刚拔掉的那颗牙的牙洞。

article.en: I suddenly felt very worried, but I could not say anything.
article.zh: 我突然非常着急，但却什么也说不出来。

article.en: When the dentist at last removed the cotton wool from my mouth, I was able to tell him that he had pulled out the wrong tooth.
article.zh: 当牙医最后把药棉从我嘴里取出时，我总算能够告诉他，他拔错牙了。
